summary: Blocked before editing: the committed transport core still cannot safely support the requested multi-request Tauri/Android session integration. `serve` creates a fresh `Session` for every connection, so replay counters and nonce state reset on each reconnect; the callback receives only a `WireFrame` and has no authenticated session/replay state. The one-frame lifecycle therefore cannot implement the required authenticated pair/session/reconnect/history/queue sequence without changing the core API beyond the requested manager-only integration. No files were modified or committed.
